tha-ap498:1.1: Ghatamaṇḍadāyaka.] Sucintitaṃ bhagavantaṃ lokajeṭṭhaṃ narāsabhaṃ / upaviṭṭhaṃ mahāraññaṃ vātābādhena pīḷitaṃ /
tha-ap498:2.1: disvā cittaṃ pasādetvā ghatamaṇḍaṃ upānayiṃ. // // Katattā ācitattā ca Gaṅgā Bhagīrasī c' ayaṃ /
tha-ap498:3.1: mahāsamuddā cattāro ghataṃ sampajjare mama. // // Ayañ ca paṭhavī ghorā appamāṇā asaṅkhiyā /
tha-ap498:4.1: mama saṅkappam aññāya bhavate madhusakkarā. // // Cātuddīpā ime rukkhā pādapā dharaṇīruhā /
tha-ap498:5.1: mama saṅkappam aññāya kapparukkhā bhavanti te. // // Paññāsakkhattuṃ devindo devarajjam akārayiṃ /
tha-ap498:6.1: ekapaññāsakkhattuñ ca cakkavatti ahos' ahaṃ / padesarajjaṃ vipulaṃ gaṇanāto asaṅkhiyaṃ. // //
tha-ap498:7.1: Catunavute ito kappe yaṃ *dānaṃ adadiṃ tadā* / duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi ghatamaṇḍass' idaṃ phalaṃ.
tha-ap498:11.1: Itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā Ghatamaṇḍadāyako th. i. g. a-ti.
